issues.legal_issue: Deemed vesting without actual taking of possession does not preserve land-ceiling proceedings after repeal becomes operative.
material_facts: The land had been treated as vested in the government after action under the statutory vesting and possession provisions.
A notice had called on the appellant to hand over possession, but the record contained no indication that the government or an authorized person had actually taken possession.
The government’s counsel accepted that actual possession had not been taken; the High Court had dismissed the petition on the basis of deemed vesting.
The repeal had become operative in the state while the proceedings concerning the land remained unresolved.
issues.conclusion: The proceedings concerning the land stood abated, and the appeal was allowed to that extent.
issues.legal_principle: Under Sections 2 and 3(1)(a) of the Urban Land (Ceiling and Regulation) Repeal Act, 1999, the saving for land vested under Section 10(3) of the principal Act applies only where possession has also been taken by the government, an authorized person, or the competent authority. Mere vesting by operation of law is insufficient; proceedings do not survive repeal where possession was not taken. This accords with Ritesh Tewari v. State of Uttar Pradesh and the authorities it relies on: Pt. Madan Swaroop Shrotiya Public Charitable Trust v. State of U.P., Ghasitey Lal Sahu v. Competent Authority, Mukarram Ali Khan v. State of U.P., and Sulochana Chandrakant Galande v. Pune Municipal Transport.

rule.if: land_ceiling_proceeding and repeal_operated and deemed_vesting and not actual_possession_taken

predicates.land_ceiling_proceeding: The matter concerns proceedings to regulate land under a land-ceiling regime.
predicates.repeal_operated: The repeal of the land-ceiling regime became operative in the relevant state.
predicates.deemed_vesting: The land was treated as vested in the government by operation of law.
predicates.actual_possession_taken: The government, an authorized person, or a competent authority actually took possession of the land.

issues.definition: When a land-ceiling proceeding concerns land treated as vested in the government, the repeal has become operative, and no authorized actor actually took possession, the proceeding abates.
